 THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF CR.P.C., PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR AND COMPLAINT IN CRIME NO.385/2021 OF BIDADI POLICE STATION, BIDADI,
RAMANAGARA DISTRICT, FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 420, 406, 323, 324, 504, 506 R/W SECTION 149 OF IPC AND U/S 3, 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT 1961 PENDING ON THE FILE OF HONBLE PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE (JR-DVN) AND JMFC COURT RAMANAGARA, AGAINST THE PETITIONERS ON THE BASIS OF THE COMPLAINT LODGED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2.

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

ORDER Petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in Crime No.385 of 2021 pending before the Principal Civil Judge (Jr. Dn.) & JMFC Court, Ramanagara for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 420, 406, 323, 324, 504 and 506 of the IPC.
2.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute amongst themselves and have filed a memorandum of settlement before this Court.

The settlement insofar as the present petition is concerned reads as follows:
".... .... ....
6.

In view of the settlement arrived between the parties the respondent has agreed to withdraw Crl.
Misc. No.41/2022 filed under Section 12 of D.V Act, pending on the file of -MMTC-111, Bengaluru.

7. In view of the settlement arrived between the parties the respondent has agreed to cooperate with the petitioner for closure/quashing as per law, the Crime No. 385/2021 filed under Section 498-A,
420, 406, 323, 324, 504, 506 r/w 34 of IPC and sections 3 & 4 of D P Act, pending before Bidadi Police Station, Ramanagar District filed against the petitioner and his family members and including car driver.
8. The parties also hereby state and agree that they do not have any claims over the moveable or immoveable assets belonging to each other, either existing or to be acquired in future."

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offence being the ones punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and not against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the same and close the proceedings against the petitioner.
